description: Ministry of Provincial Road, Transport, Co-Operative Devilopment - Western Province - Closure of Liquidation of the Co-Operative Societies
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the closure of liquidation for multiple cooperative societies under specific statutes. The content deals with business/commercial matters (cooperative society dissolutions and regulatory compliance), falling under Commercial Gazettes (Type 6) as it involves the formal termination of business entities under commercial regulations.
